div.div:
Notes
*1 Origin is the dividing line
Managed services need Internet origin; compute inside a VPC uses VPC origin. The origin cannot be changed after creation.
*2 What is not drawn is not "unsupported"
AWS DataSync, AWS Backup, Amazon Macie, Amazon GuardDuty, AWS Storage Gateway and others: no public statement was found. The table in the text lists what was searched.
*3 The basis differs per row
The table in the text separates AWS documentation, measurements in this and other repositories, and vendor-published statements.
